ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 dated 15 November 2022 (effective 1 December 2022); Decree No. 34/2023/ND-CP dated 21 June 2023 detailing anti-money-laundering implementation measures; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (membership register, legal representative and beneficial-owner information); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH20 (foreign-invested LLC market access and nominee prohibitions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation / business registration certificate of every corporate UBO in the ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State company registry / competent registrar in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (where the issuing state is a Contracting Party to the 1961 Apostille Convention); consular legalization at a Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate for non-Apostille states

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, Articles 24-35 and Article 47 (charter capital contribution and LLC governance); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 37-38 (foreign investment registration); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration, Articles 28-32; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP on investment registration procedures, Articles 29-32; Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14; Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally governed city where the head office is located - Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh); National Business Registration Portal (hkd.dkkd.gov.vn); for projects located in industrial zones or export processing zones, the Management Board of the Industrial Zone (BQL KCN) is the competent registration authority.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application Form I.1 for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) and Application Form A.I.1 for Investment Project Registration (Giấy đề nghị thực hiện dự án đầu tư)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum charter capital applies because the webtoon digital publishing activity is not a conditional business line and the enterprise profile carries a self-declared charter capital. The charter capital must be expressed in VND and paid in full within 90 days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Article 47.2 of Law on Enterprises 59/2020/QH14). No escrow account or capital-blocking account is required; contributed capital must be physically deposited into a bank account of the LLC opened at a licensed commercial bank or foreign bank branch in Viet Nam. If a member fails to contribute on time, the unpaid portion becomes a debt of that member owed to the LLC, and the Members' Council must adjust the registered charter capital by filing a change with the Business Registration Office within 30 days after the payment deadline.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST MEMBERS' COUNCIL RESOLUTION NO. 01/2025/HĐTV-LLC of [COMPANY NAME], a foreign-invested limited liability company being incorporated in the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam. The undersigned members, being the lawful subscribers to the charter capital of the Company, hereby adopt the following resolutions pursuant to the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14:
1. Share Capital and Contribution: The charter capital of the Company is fixed at the amount stated in the Company Charter and the List of Members. Each member subscribes to the capital contributions set opposite his/her/its name in the List of Members, which contributions shall be fully paid in VND into the Company's contribution bank account within ninety (90) days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. The General Director is hereby authorized to open such bank account and to execute all necessary instruments to receive the capital contributions.
2. Registered Office: The Company adopts [full legal address in Viet Nam] as its registered head office, its legal domicile, and the venue for service of lawful process, official correspondence, tax notices and judicial documents.
3. Appointment of Officers: The Members' Council unanimously appoints: (a) [Full Name], Chairman of the Members' Council; (b) [Full Name], General Director (Chief Executive Officer); and (c) [Full Name], Legal Representative (Người đại diện theo pháp luật) as designated in the Company Charter. Each appointee accepts the office and shall act in strict accordance with the Company Charter and Vietnamese law.
4. Delegation of Implementation: The General Director and the Legal Representative, jointly and severally, are authorized to prepare, sign, file and prosecute all applications, declarations, powers of attorney and other instruments necessary to obtain the Investment Registration Certificate and the Enterprise Registration Certificate, to publish registration contents on the National Business Registration Portal, to make the company seal, to register tax obligations and electronic invoices, to open bank mandates, to execute the office lease and utility contracts, and to do all lawful acts required for the formation and commencement of business of the Company in Viet Nam.
5. Governing Law and Validity: This Resolution is adopted by the unanimous written consent of all members on [date] at [place]. It is prepared in Vietnamese; this English version is for convenience only and shall not prevail over the Vietnamese text. The Resolution is binding upon the Company and all members with immediate effect.
SIGNATURES: [Members or their authorized representatives]

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Incorporation Legalization, Translation and Notarization of Constituent Dossiers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Notary Office (Văn phòng công chứng) in the province of the proposed registered office; Ministry of Foreign Affairs and/or provincial Department of Foreign Affairs for consular legalization/apostille verification of foreign-issued documents; court interpreters for certified Vietnamese translation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign member must have all foreign-origin documents (passport, certificate of incorporation, financial capacity evidence) consularized or apostilled, translated into Vietnamese by an accredited translator, and certified at a Vietnamese notary office. The Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty) and the List of Members (Danh sách thành viên) must be drafted in Vietnamese and signed by all members or their lawful representatives before a notary. The future legal representative must obtain a criminal record extract (Phiếu lý lịch tư pháp) from the provincial Department of Justice. A lease agreement or a letter of commitment from the landlord for the registered office address must also be secured at this stage.
required_dossiers: Notarized Company Charter in Vietnamese (content per Article 26, Law on Enterprises 2020)
Notarized List of Members and capital contribution amounts
Certified Vietnamese translation of each foreign member's passport or Certificate of Incorporation, with consular legalization/apostille
Bank certificate evidencing the foreign investor's financial capacity
Notarized lease agreement or landlord commitment letter for the registered office address
Criminal record extract of the Vietnamese legal representative issued within the last 6 months
Power of attorney appointing the Vietnamese authorized representative, notarized and legalized as applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notary rejects a document due to defective translation or missing legalization, the applicant must have the document re-translated by a recognized translator and re-certified, or complete the consular/apostille stamp at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and resubmit. Notary refusals are not administratively appealable; the applicant cures the defect and re-submits. If the criminal record extract is delayed, the applicant may apply for an expedited issuance or use an online judicial record service.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) Application for the Foreign-Invested Project
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) - Division of Investment Registration, through the National Investment and Foreign Investment Portal (dautunuocngoai.gov.vn) or the provincial public service portal; for projects inside an export processing zone or industrial park, the Management Board of the Industrial Zone (BQL KCN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Since the company is foreign-invested, an Investment Registration Certificate must be obtained under the Investment Law 2020 prior to or concurrently with enterprise registration. The applicant submits an online dossier containing the investment project application form, the proposed project objectives and scale, location of headquarters, forms of capital contribution, and the investor's legal and financial capacity documents. The webtoon publication activity is not listed in Annex IV of Decree 31/2021/ND-CP as a conditional business line; therefore, the project proceeds under the standard non-conditional procedure. The DPI reviews the dossier and issues the IRC within 15 working days. The IRC will state the foreign invested project code, the investor, the capital amount, and the project implementation term.
required_dossiers: Investment registration application form (Form A.I.1 per Decree 31/2021)
Investment project proposal (project objectives, scale, investment capital, location, schedule)
Financial capacity statement of the investor, e.g., bank deposit balance certificate or audited financial statements
Certified copy of the foreign member's passport or legal entity Certificate of Incorporation with consular legalization
Lease agreement, MOU, or landlord commitment for the proposed head-office address
Power of attorney for the authorized representative filing the dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a request for supplementation (yêu cầu sửa đổi, bổ sung hồ sơ), the investor is allowed 10 working days to cure. If the DPI rejects the project, the investor may file a complaint with the DPI Director or the provincial People's Committee, or initiate an administrative lawsuit at the competent people's court in accordance with the Law on Complaints 2011 and the Law on Administrative Procedures 2015. Alternatively, the investor may revise the proposal and resubmit a fresh application without prejudice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Registration and Issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment - Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) via the National Business Registration Portal (hkd.dkkd.gov.vn) or the online public service portal (DichVuCong.gov.vn)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the IRC, the authorized representative submits the enterprise registration dossier online using a digital signature, or in person at the DPI. The dossier comprises the enterprise registration application, the Company Charter, the List of Members, the IRC, and identity documents of the legal representative. The DPI verifies the company name (uniqueness and prohibition on confusingly similar names), the legality of the charter, and the lawful residence of the legal representative. The LLC is issued the Enterprise Registration Certificate within 3 working days. The ERC contains the enterprise code, which is simultaneously the tax identification number (TIN), and the company exists as a separate legal entity from that date.
required_dossiers: Enterprise registration application form (Form I.1)
Company Charter signed by all members or their lawful representatives
List of Members and their capital contributions (Form I.2)
Effective Investment Registration Certificate
Notarized copies of identity documents of all members and the legal representative
Judicial record extract of the legal representative
Certified copy of the resolution/decision of each organizational member approving the capital contribution to the LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested company name is refused because it duplicates or confuses with an existing name, the DPI provides reasons in a written notice; the applicant selects an alternative name and resubmits. If the dossier is incomplete, the applicant must cure within 10 working days per Articles 29-30 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP. If the DPI fails to issue the ERC within the statutory 3 working days without a lawful reason, the applicant may file a complaint with the DPI Director or an administrative action; a written acknowledgment from the DPI is sufficient to trigger liability for illegal administrative delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening the Charter Capital Contribution Bank Account and Completion of Capital Deposits
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial banks and foreign bank branches in Viet Nam (e.g., Vietcombank, BIDV, Techcombank, HSBC Bank Vietnam); State Bank of Viet Nam governed capital account rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The General Director obtains the company seal and attends the bank with the ERC, the company charter, and the authorized signatories' identity documents to open a corporate bank account in the name of the LLC. The bank issues a certificate of deposit account opening. Each member must transfer their subscribed charter capital contribution in full within 90 days from the ERC date. Contributions are normally made in VND; if foreign currency is permitted under the charter, the bank will handle the conversion. After each remittance, the company obtains the bank statement or credit confirmation evidencing the contribution. This forms the basis for the later capital contribution confirmation minutes and audited financial statement.
required_dossiers: Original Enterprise Registration Certificate and certified copies
Resolution or minutes of the Members' Council appointing bank account signatories
Power of attorney for the bank signatories
Company seal and seal sample card
Proof of registered office address (lease agreement and landlord's identification)
Company Charter and List of Members
Passport/identity card of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a member fails to pay the contributed capital within the statutory 90-day period, the unpaid portion automatically becomes a debt of that member to the company bearing interest at the prevailing commercial rate under Article 47.4 of the Law on Enterprises. The Members' Council is obligated to convene an extraordinary meeting, adjust the registered charter capital to the actually paid amount, and file a change notice with the Business Registration Office within 30 days from the expiry of the 90-day period. Persistent failure may lead to dissolution if the adjusted capital falls below any lawful minimum; however, no minimum applies to this non-conditional business line.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Kickoff: Publication on National Portal, Common Seal Declaration, Tax Compliance and Labour Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (publication requirement); Provincial Police/Public Security for seal-related formalities; General Department of Taxation and provincial Tax Department (electronic invoices, tax filings); DOLISA (labour registration and foreign work permits); Viet Nam Social Security
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of receiving the ERC, the legal representative publishes the company's registration content on the National Business Registration Portal and pays the publication fee. The common seal is created at a licensed seal-carving establishment and a seal sample declaration is filed with the Business Registration Office. The first Members' Council meeting is convened to adopt organizational governance rules, approve the internal authorization matrix, and issue the company's operational mandate. The company activates the enterprise code for tax purposes on the eTax system of the General Department of Taxation, registers for electronic invoice use, and enrolls for social insurance and health insurance for employees. If foreign staff will be transferred, work permit applications are submitted to DOLISA. The company also registers occupational safety and health compliance documentation and workplace risk assessments as required by Vietnamese labour legislation. This step completes the statutory formation and governance phase.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate
Proof of publication fee payment and the confirmatory page from the National Business Registration Portal
Seal sample declaration (Form IV.1) and seal carving invoice
Minutes of the first Members' Council meeting adopting governance rules
Decision approving internal corporate governance regulations
Application for electronic invoice registration (with digital signature certificate)
Labour usage registration form to DOLISA; work permit application files for foreign employees
Occupational safety and health registration and risk assessment documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to publish registration content within the 30-day statutory window attracts administrative fines under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP (warning or monetary penalty of VND 2,000,000 to VND 5,000,000). Late electronic invoice registration may trigger penalties under the Law on Tax Administration 2019 and interest on late tax payments. Missing work permits are sanctioned by the Labour Inspectorate. These are curable administrative violations: the company should make late filings promptly, pay any administrative fines, and conduct internal remedial compliance to avoid escalation to suspension of the enterprise code by the tax authority.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial manufacturing licence is applicable to a non-manufacturing digital webtoon publishing business. The sectoral regulator for online information and digital content is the Authority of Broadcasting and Electronic Information (ABEI) under the Ministry of Information and Communications (MIC), and copyright and related rights are administered by the Copyright Office of Viet Nam (COV) under the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MOCST).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - webtoon digital publishing and syndication is a non-conditional service activity under Vietnamese law and is not listed in Annex IV of Decree 31/2021/ND-CP. No prior operating licence is required for the core business; the company is subject only to general self-regulatory content notice and labelling obligations under Decree 71/2021/ND-CP as amended by Decree 147/2024/ND-CP, which are notice-type compliance duties rather than a licensing requirement.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) - Viet Nam Environment Administration (VEA); provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) at the location of the registered office
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category III non-manufacturing office/digital service project. The webtoon publishing activity is not listed in Appendices II, III or IV of Decree 08/2022/ND-CP, and therefore no Full EIA Report, Preliminary EIA Screening or Environmental Permit is required. The company remains subject to ordinary municipal environmental sanitation and public health obligations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Sanitary wastewater discharged into the municipal sewer system must satisfy QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT (domestic wastewater, column A or B depending on receiving sewer capacity); if an on-site wastewater treatment plant is installed, effluent compliance with QCVN 63:2018/BTNMT is required. Solid waste must be source-separated per the Law on Environmental Protection 2020 and collected by a licensed waste collection enterprise. Hazardous waste (used toners, e-waste, batteries) is governed by Circular 02/2022/TT-BTNMT; registration with DONRE is necessary only if hazardous waste generation exceeds 600 kg per year, which is unlikely for an office-based digital publisher. Noise and vibration limits for the office area follow QCVN 26:2010/BTNMT and QCVN 27:2010/BTNMT. No industrial VOC, NOx, SO2 or particulate emission standards apply because the operation has no combustion or production process beyond ordinary office HVAC and server equipment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards_note: The digital nature of the business creates no process wastewater or atmospheric pollutants; the enterprise's obligations are limited to domestic sewage, municipal solid waste, and electrical/electronic equipment waste disposal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety: the company must obtain Fire Prevention and Rescue Police approval of the fire safety design for its office fit-out before construction works, and after completion a Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate (Văn bản nghiệm thu về PCCC) is required under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP as amended by Decree 83/2023/ND-CP; annual self-inspection and maintenance of fire-fighting equipment and evacuation routes are mandatory. Structural load: the office lease must be supported by the building's construction acceptance certificate and the floor-load capacity must accommodate server racks, data cabinets and uninterruptible power supplies; a structural compliance certificate from the building owner may be requested. Occupational safety: the company must conduct a workplace hazard assessment, occupational hygiene monitoring (microclimate, noise, lighting, electromagnetic fields), provide safety training to employees, and register occupational safety and health self-assessment results with the provincial DOLISA in accordance with the Law on Occupational Safety and Health 2015 and Decree 44/2016/ND-CP; ergonomic risk prevention for employees working with video display terminals is required as good practice and industry standard. Workplaces with employees engaged in screen-based activities are subject to the general workplace environmental quality thresholds: lighting levels per QCVN 22:2016/BYT, microclimate per QCVN 26:2016/BYT, and ventilation per QCVN 27:2016/BYT.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế), Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam; national e-tax portals: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn (domestic taxpayers) and https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn (foreign suppliers without a Vietnamese establishment); e-invoice portal: https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested LLC obtains its Tax Identification Number (MST) through the enterprise registration process as follows: (1) apply for an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), an Industrial Zone Authority, or the Special Investment Supervisory Agency where applicable; (2) submit the online enterprise registration dossier to the provincial DPI to obtain an Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); (3) the Enterprise Code printed on the ERC is automatically the Tax Identification Number (MST) pursuant to the Enterprise Law 2020 (Law 59/2020/QH14) and the Law on Tax Administration (Law 38/2019/QH14), so no separate lottery-style TIN application exists; (4) within 30 days of ERC issuance, complete supplementary tax registration via the online tax registration system (đăng ký thuế lần đầu) at the tax authority's one-stop portal and receive the electronic Tax Registration Confirmation (Giấy xác nhận đăng ký thuế); (5) activate an e-tax account on the GDT e-tax portal, register for mandatory e-invoices under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP, and register for the declared tax payment method (khai thuế, nộp thuế điện tử).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; a foreign-invested LLC is mandatorily a tax resident of Vietnam for corporate income tax (CIT) purposes under the Law on Corporate Income Tax (Law 14/2008/QH12 as amended by Law 32/2013/QH13 and Law 106/2016/QH13), subject to a 20% CIT on worldwide income with a foreign tax credit available under bilateral tax treaties; the LLC is not a pass-through entity and no partnership-style flow-through is recognized under Vietnamese law.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid entity election regime exists in Vietnam. A foreign-invested LLC cannot elect to be taxed as an individual, partnership, or branch; full entity-level taxation is mandatory. There are no hybrid mismatch election mechanisms; BEPS Action 2 outcomes are not domestically enacted, but related-party certainty is governed by Decree 132/2020/ND-CP on transfer pricing and the General Anti-Avoidance Rule contained in Article 8 of Law 38/2019/QH14, which authorizes the tax authority to disregard transactions without economic substance.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (GTGT) under the Law on Value Added Tax (Law 13/2008/QH12 as amended by Law 106/2016/QH13), Decree 209/2013/ND-CP and Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC; statutory headline rate is temporarily reduced to 8% for certain eligible goods and services under Resolution 43/2022/QH15 as extended by Decree 180/2024/ND-CP until 30 June 2025, but digital electronic content subscriptions remain subject to the standard 10% headline rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover exemption threshold applies to LLCs: every enterprise must register for VAT upon ERC issuance regardless of revenue level. For comparison, households and individual businesses are subject to VAT registration only if annual revenue exceeds VND 100,000,000 (per the Law on Personal Income Tax and VAT administration guidance). Foreign digital suppliers of e-commerce goods/services without a Vietnamese establishment must register, declare, and pay VAT and CIT through the GDT foreign supplier portal (etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn) with no minimum registration threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing with fiscal data transmission to the General Department of Taxation is fully effective for all Vietnamese enterprises from 1 July 2022 under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. E-invoices must be issued in XML format with a digital signature and a two-dimensional QR data matrix; invoices must be issued with a tax authority-issued code for B2C sales. For e-invoices without a tax code, the full e-invoice data file must be transmitted to the GDT e-invoice portal within 24 hours of issuance; for coded invoices, the code assignment is performed real-time by the GDT system before issuance to the buyer. Cash-register-type invoices, if used in a physical retail scenario, must transmit data in real time from the fiscal data device to the GDT. There is no VAT-group consolidation or fiscal-warehouse for digital content: the invoice must record the placing of free-to-paid subscription conversion, VAT breakdown, and the customer's VAT ID or passport number, and all e-invoice data must be archived for 10 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: An exported digital webtoon/electronic publishing supply (including subscription-unlocking services and multilingual chapter-license content) qualifies for 0% VAT under Article 9.3 of Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC when ALL of the following conditions are satisfied: (i) a written foreign service contract is concluded with a foreign party (or a binding online terms-of-service with non-resident end-users); (ii) the service is actually performed and consumed outside Vietnam, evidenced by subscriber geolocation/IP-address logs, platform-analytics reporting, and foreign bank receipt; (iii) the consideration is received in a freely convertible foreign currency via electronic transfer into an account at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank; and (iv) the LLC retains a complete substantiation file for its service-export claims. Service supplies to foreign parties that are attributable to domestic Vietnamese users or that form part of a domestic value chain are NOT zero-rated and are subject to 10% VAT. Revenue routed through Apple IAP / Google Play Billing must be carefully split: the app-store commission is a separately imported international digital service and the Vietnamese LLC must concurrently zero-rate the net proceeds of non-resident consumer subscriptions; domestic consumer purchases remain standard-rate supplies, with the app store's commission withheld by the platform subject to the foreign contractor tax regime.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (HQ/2015-XK electronic declaration) — required only if physical merchandise or tangible media is co-exported with the digital webtoon content; zero-rating of pure intangible digital services does not use a customs declaration.

Export Service Contract or binding online terms-of-service agreement with the foreign party / non-resident end-user, with a clear statement of offshore consumption and pricing schedule per chapter or subscription tier.
Commercial invoice and zero-rated VAT e-invoice issued under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP, with the 0% VAT line item, VAT rate code, and mention of the Article 9 Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC zero-rating basis.

Inward Remittance Certificate (Chứng từ thanh toán qua ngân hàng) or bank credit advice evidencing net proceeds received in a convertible foreign currency from abroad into an account at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank.

Offshore-consumption evidence pack: non-resident subscriber reports from Apple IAP / Google Play Billing, IP-geolocation logs, viewer-country analytics, and user-identification metadata demonstrating that content is delivered outside Vietnamese territory.

App-store commission substantiation: Apple/Google merchant-of-record statements and foreign contractor tax registration evidence, to support the app-store commission as a separate imported digital service with its own VAT/GST treatment.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT maintains a high-scrutiny refund-control list for zero-rated service exporters and applies retrospective post-refund audits. For fraudulent zero-rating or VAT-refund claims, the legal penalties are: (i) evasion penalties under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP of 1 to 3 times the evaded VAT amount, plus late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; (ii) false-underclearance of VAT that is not criminal evasion attracts a 20% supplementary tax penalty plus late-payment interest; (iii) the VAT refund is clawed back in full with interest from the date of refund disbursement; (iv) criminal liability under Article 200 of the Penal Code 2015 (as amended 2017) — tax evasion from VND 100,000,000 or with aggravating circumstances carries imprisonment of 6 months to 7 years, with evasion exceeding VND 1,000,000,000 attracting up to 20 years' imprisonment, plus fines up to VND 4,500,000,000; (v) a claim for VAT refund of export services that fails the offshore-consumption documentation test within the 180-day repatriation deadline results in automatic rejection of the zero-rate and conversion of the supply to 10% standard-rated output, with under-declared VAT recovered, penalty, and interest; and (vi) the responsible legal representative and chief accountant may be administratively fined and, in egregious schemes, criminally prosecuted for refund fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) - Ngan hang Nha nuoc Viet Nam, acting through the Foreign Exchange Management Department and authorized commercial banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: VND is not freely convertible offshore. Current-account transactions, including cross-border webtoon licensing royalties, syndication fees, and profit remittances after audited financial statements and tax clearance, are generally convertible through authorized banks with appropriate underlying documentation. Capital-account transactions, such as charter capital injections and cross-border shareholder loans, require SBV registration or permission and are strictly monitored. Foreign investors are permitted to remit profits in VND-convertible foreign currency once annually after completion of statutory tax and audit requirements. All FX conversions must take place onshore through a licensed credit institution; offshore market trading in VND is restricted.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds, including digital content syndication revenue from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, must be repatriated to a foreign-currency account held at an authorized bank in Vietnam within the contractual settlement period, generally not exceeding 120 days from the service performance or invoice date unless a longer payment term is approved by the bank. The mandatory conversion ratio for private-sector exporters is currently set at 0% of export receipts under normal conditions; however, the SBV may impose a temporary surrender ratio during balance-of-payments emergencies. The LLC should retain USD receipts offshore only to the extent expressly permitted, but standard compliance requires all proceeds to flow into an onshore VND/USD operational account and conversion to VND to occur only for local operating expenditures.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Techcombank)
Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for primary treasury operations. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise, Payoneer, and Revolut cannot act as the main corporate banking rail for a Vietnamese LLC because they are not authorized credit institutions under SBV regulations and cannot provide onshore VND or VND-denominated current accounts. They may be used only as ancillary collection vehicles for micro-inbound IAP/PayPal receipts of foreign platforms, subject to strict enterprise bookkeeping and tax reconciliation, but all explicit foreign-exchange conversion and Vietnamese statutory disbursements must be conducted through an SBV-licensed bank. Any unlicensed payment service activity in Vietnam carries criminal and administrative enforcement risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person KYC is mandated for corporate account opening. At least one director or a holder of a notarized power of attorney authorized by the board must physically attend an interview at the bank branch in Vietnam. Original corporate documents, seals (if maintained), and UBO identification must be submitted. Remote e-KYC is generally accepted only for individual customers, not for foreign-invested limited liability companies. Some tier-1 banks may permit a supplementary video call after the physical interview, but the initial face-to-face presence is effectively non-waivable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency, low-value inbound payments from Apple and Google platform treasury entities without standard commercial invoices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Digital content distribution agreements with Apple/Google, consolidated platform payout statements, monthly sales reports by country, e-invoices issued under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP, and a treasury reconciliation memo explaining IAP/Google Play Billing revenue aggregation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments routed from offshore related parties or holding companies in tax-advantaged jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Group organizational chart, certificates of incorporation, UBO registers, intercompany webtoon licensing agreement, valuation analysis, transfer pricing documentation under Circular 132/2020/TT-BTC, and OECD-aligned arm's-length evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid pass-through FX conversion with immediate outbound wire to foreign shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury policy, cash-management operating manual, board resolution delegating FX trade authority, underlying invoices or loan agreements, formal cross-border loan registration (where applicable), and SBV-compliant payment purpose codes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed LLC with high projected digital revenue but low paid-in capital and limited local substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan, webtoon production contracts, creator and artist agreements in Vietnam, office lease, payroll records, bank capitalization certificate evidencing capital contribution, and IRC/ERC as issued by the provincial planning authority.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident individual UBO or authorized signatory linked to a high-risk jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport copies, proof of address, source-of-wealth statement, sanctions/PEP screening report, notarized power of attorney, personal tax residency certificate, and independent legal opinion confirming UBO identity and legal capacity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Charter capital injections must be routed as SWIFT MT103 wires from the overseas shareholder to the LLC's dedicated capital contribution account at an authorized bank in Vietnam. The remittance must reference the company name, Investment Registration Certificate number, and purpose code 'Direct Investment Capital Contribution'. Supporting documents include the IRC, enterprise registration certificate, board resolution approving capital schedule, and shareholder identity documents. For cross-border shareholder loans, the LLC must complete SBV enterprise foreign loan registration before drawdown, and the inbound wire must reference the registered loan contract. For operating revenue from webtoon syndication, inbound payments from Apple/Google should arrive via ordinary SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'Export service income from digital content platform' and be credited to the USD operational account; the bank will verify the commercial invoice and platform payout statement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For recurring digital-content royalties and syndication fees, the primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 via the LLC's corporate online banking portal. Outbound wires must include accurate purpose codes, the underlying license or distribution agreement, tax invoices, and evidence of withholding tax payment (Vietnamese WHT on royalty/service payments). MT202 COV may be used for interbank settlement for larger group-level liquidity transfers. Commercial letters of credit are not the standard rail for digital webtoon transactions, but a standby LC or documentary collection may be used for large physical merchandising or exclusive distribution milestones. All outbound transactions are subject to SBV reporting through the bank's foreign exchange reporting system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore VND/USD outright forward contracts with licensed banks, backed by real commercial exposures
Onshore FX swap contracts (VND/USD) with licensed credit institutions
Cross-currency swap contracts approved by the bank for material long-term syndication liabilities
FX options contracts traded with licensed banks, subject to underlying transaction validation
Offshore VND non-deliverable forwards via non-resident banks only when used for balance-sheet hedging and with clear underlying export agreements; speculative NDF use is prohibited

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Finalization Return – Form quyết toán thuế TNDN for the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Sub-Department where the LLC head office is registered, transmitted through the national e-tax filing portal (etax).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 90th day after the financial year-end; for a calendar-year reporting period, by 31 March of the following year. No extension is available for the annual finalization return.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VND 2,000,000-25,000,000 (approx. USD 80-1,000) under Decree 125/2020/NĐ-CP, plus daily late-payment interest of 0.03% on underpaid CIT; prolonged non-filing with no activity at the registered address triggers a 6-month notice and administrative dissolution under Article 209 of the Enterprise Law 2020.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm) including the independent auditor's report for a foreign-invested LLC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Sub-Department and the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI - Enterprise Registration Office).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days of the financial year-end (31 March for a calendar-year entity); the audited statements, once signed, must be lodged with the tax authority and DPI within 30 days after the statutory audit opinion is issued.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty of VND 10,000,000-30,000,000 (approx. USD 400-1,200) for non-submission or late submission of audited financial statements; the tax and business-registration records mark the enterprise as non-compliant, and a second consecutive year of non-filing is treated as a strike-off risk factor.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Investment Project Implementation Report (Báo cáo tình hình thực hiện dự án đầu tư) required of the foreign-invested webtoon publishing project
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Registration Authority (Provincial DPI or the Export Processing Authority if the entity is located in an export processing zone).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before 31 March of the following calendar year; content covers capital disbursement, staffing, revenue, and project activity status.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of approximately VND 5,000,000-20,000,000 (approx. USD 200-800) for late or defective investor reporting; persistent failure to report may lead the investment registration authority to terminate the Investment Registration Certificate, which in turn dissolves the foreign-invested enterprise.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee (lệ phí môn bài) declaration and payment for maintaining the Enterprise Registration Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Tax Sub-Department of the locality where the head office is registered, submitted through the e-tax e-filing system.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 January of each calendar year; newly incorporated enterprises must declare and pay within 30 days after issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. Fee tier is based on registered charter capital (VND 2,000,000 per annum for charter capital not exceeding VND 10 billion, approximately USD 80).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on the unpaid license fee, together with an administrative fine of VND 1,000,000-5,000,000 (approx. USD 40-200); persistent non-payment disqualifies the enterprise from tax good-standing certificates and contributes to the annual strike-off assessment.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Foreign-invested enterprises, including a 100% foreign-owned VN LLC, are mandatorily subject to an independent annual audit regardless of revenue or asset size (Law on Independent Audit No. 67/2011/QH13 and related MOF guidance). A non-foreign-invested LLC is subject to mandatory audit when it qualifies as a large-scale enterprise under the MOF quantitative tests (typically total assets exceeding VND 100 billion or annual revenue exceeding VND 200-250 billion, as periodically updated).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Local GAAP of Viet Nam, i.e., Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS), applied together with Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC for enterprise financial statements and Circular 202/2014/TT-BTC for consolidated statements. IFRS may be applied only with the approval of the Ministry of Finance under Decree 83/2020/NĐ-CP. Books must be maintained in VND; the audited financial statements of this foreign-invested webtoon LLC must be prepared in Vietnamese and submitted to the tax authority and DPI.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Viet Nam imposes no standalone annual UBO declaration on a non-financial digital-content publisher. Annual confirmation of shareholding and membership is embedded in the audited financial statements, the CIT finalization dossier, and the annually updated Register of Members. Where a shareholding transfer occurs, the transfer becomes effective against the LLC only when the transferee's name is entered in the Register of Members under the Enterprise Law 2020; the LLC must notify the DPI of any change in members or charter capital within 30 days, and foreign-investor ownership changes require a corresponding adjustment to the Investment Registration Certificate. The Register of Members must be brought current at each annual audit sign-off.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Sổ đăng ký thành viên) - statutory list of quota holders and their capital contributions under the Enterprise Law 2020
Register of Directors / Member Council and General Director appointments, reappointments, and revocations
Minute Book (Sổ biên bản) recording Member Council resolutions, annual financial statement approvals, capital increases or decreases, and general governance decisions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,000-3,500 per annum for registered-office and domicile support at the Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi head-office address; USD 2,000-5,000 per annum for outsourced corporate secretarial, bookkeeping, and tax compliance agency services.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500-5,500 per annum for a small-to-mid digital webtoon publisher through a Vietnamese licensed audit firm, dependent on Apple IAP and Google Play Billing transaction volume; Big Four firms commonly quote above USD 10,000 for the same engagement.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The standard headline CIT rate in Viet Nam is 20%. A foreign-invested LLC engaged in digital webtoon publication may qualify for preferential tax treatment only if it obtains an investment registration certificate for an encouraged sector or location. Eligible new investment projects in high-tech, software, creative digital content, or qualifying economic zones may enjoy a preferential CIT rate of 10% for a fixed term (commonly 15 years), plus CIT holidays (commonly exemption for up to 4 years and 50% reduction for up to 9 years), subject to strict turnover and licensing conditions. Absent certification, the effective rate is the standard 20%. SMEs meeting statutory definitions may access other temporary preferential rates under specific government incentive programs. Revenue from digital content distribution is generally sourced in Viet Nam and fully taxable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 01/TNDN - Quarterly Provisional CIT Declaration (Tờ khai thuế thu nhập doanh nghiệp tạm tính); electronically filed via the Vietnamese National Tax Portal (Etax) at https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due no later than the last day of the first month following each calendar quarter. For a calendar-year filer, the deadlines are 30 April, 31 July, 31 October, and 31 January. The LLC must pay at least 80% of the annual CIT liability through the quarterly provisional payments by the final quarter; shortfall between quarterly installments and final assessed CIT is subject to late-payment interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A - Tax Period and Taxpayer Identification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identify the tax period (quarter and fiscal year) and enter the Legal Entity Tax Identification Number (MST) of the Vietnamese LLC, the legal representative, and registered business address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Vietnamese LLC is the sole CIT filer. Foreign shareholders are not required to co-sign. The legal representative, regardless of residence, must certify the declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter provisional quarterly gross turnover from all Vietnamese-source business activities, including gross proceeds from digital webtoon chapter unlocking and syndication via Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, and similar platforms. Platform commissions are not netted in revenue; they may be deductible expenses if supported by proper contracts and invoices.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners must ensure that the Vietnamese LLC records gross revenue on all digital sales in Viet Nam. Active business income is not eligible for DTA reduction; failure to report gross revenue is treated as underdeclaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter provisional deductible expenses with valid supporting invoices: content creation, translation/subtitling, platform store fees, hosting, royalties, salaries, depreciation, and administrative costs. Related-party payments must comply with the arm's-length principle and transfer pricing documentation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to a foreign parent or related licensor for webtoon IP rights may be subject to Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) withholding on the gross amount if no DTA relief is obtained. Documentation of supporting contracts and TRCs must be retained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 03 - Taxable Income and CIT Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed as Line 01 minus Line 02, adjusted for non-deductible expenses, then multiplied by the applicable CIT rate to determine the quarterly provisional tax liability.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident shareholder has no direct filing obligation, but dividend distributions will be reported separately. Underprovision in quarterly returns is common when Apple/Google settlement statements are delayed; conservative estimates are required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative fines per Decree 125/2020/ND-CP, up to VND 25,000,000 for delays beyond 90 days; late payment: 0.03% daily interest on the overdue tax amount. Additional penalties apply if quarterly paid tax is less than 80% of the final assessed CIT.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 03/TNDN - Annual CIT Finalization Return, submitted together with Form 01 Related-Party Transaction Disclosure (Phụ lục Giao dịch liên kết) when related-party transactions exist; electronically filed via https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than 90 days from the end of the fiscal year. For a calendar-year taxpayer, the deadline is 31 March. A written application may allow a maximum 30-day extension. The annual return reconciles the four quarterly provisional payments with the final tax liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: State name of LLC, MST, address, authorized representative, fiscal year, and finalization confirmation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The legal representative of the Vietnamese LLC must sign and assume legal responsibility. A foreign non-resident director who is the legal representative is personally subject to Vietnamese tax enforcement, including exit bans.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate annual gross turnover from digital webtoon syndication, including in-app purchases and subscriptions through all payment rails without deduction for commissions or payment processor fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apple IAP and Google Play Billing gross settlement statements must be reconciled with bank remittances. Differences must be explained as fees or refunds; unallocated differences may be taxed as profit with penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare income exempt from CIT, such as dividends received from Vietnamese joint-stock companies or contributions to capital within Viet Nam that have already borne CIT; not applicable to digital sales revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporate shareholders receiving dividends from the LLC do not file this line. The LLC should not classify webtoon licensing or subscription income as exempt under this item absent legal basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual deductible expenses, including foreign store fees, content acquisition, editing, localization, infrastructure, and salaries. Non-deductible expenses, excess interest, entertainment over-limits, and TP adjustments are reported as add-backs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border payments for royalties and interest must be benchmarked at arm's length. Invoices from related foreign suppliers without substance are disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 4 - Taxable Income, Loss Carryforward, and CIT Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after prior-year loss carryforward (maximum 5 years) and additional adjustments; multiply by 20% CIT rate or applicable preferential rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC is the taxpayer. Non-resident shareholders cannot use LLC losses to shelter foreign income. Distribution of after-tax profit requires no further corporate-level withholding, but shareholder-level personal income tax applies if the shareholder is an individual.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual related-party transaction disclosure: types of related parties, transaction values, TP method, benchmarking conclusions, and basis for exemption from preparing Local/Master File.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Filing is mandatory whenever related-party transactions exist, even if no documentation threshold is exceeded. Non-resident beneficial owners should verify that the disclosed royalties, interest, and platform service fees align with actual functions and risks.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file by the statutory deadline triggers administrative fines up to VND 25,000,000 and daily late-payment interest of 0.03%. Underdeclaration causing CIT shortfall attracts penalty of 20% of the additional tax. Serious deliberate non-compliance exposes directors to criminal tax evasion liability under the Penal Code.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Corporate shareholders: no domestic dividend withholding tax is imposed on dividends paid by a Vietnamese LLC out of after-tax CIT profits. Individual shareholders, resident or non-resident, are subject to final personal income tax at 5% on dividend distributions; the LLC must withhold and remit that 5% to the tax authority. Therefore, for an LLC owned by foreign corporate entities, after-tax profits may be remitted overseas without additional corporate-level Vietnamese withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because dividends are not subject to domestic withholding tax for corporate shareholders, no DTA relief is required for dividend distributions. For royalty and interest payments, the foreign beneficial owner may apply the DTA reduced CIT/FCT rate by submitting a valid Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) and supporting beneficial-ownership documentation to the Vietnamese tax authority, either before payment through the Etax/attendance process or retroactively through a refund claim. The Vietnamese payer must retain the TRC, DTA relief application form, payment contracts, and evidence of beneficial ownership. Standard practice: submit the TRC and application at least 10 days before the first payment; if relief is denied, domestic FCT withholding applies on gross amounts.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory FCT combined rates: royalties paid to non-residents are subject to 10% CIT plus 5% VAT on gross payments (effective combined 15%); debt interest paid to non-residents is subject to 5% CIT plus 0% VAT (effective 5%) on gross interest. Under most Vietnamese DTAs, royalty withholding is often reduced to 10% or lower (typically 5-10% depending on the treaty and type of copyright) and interest to 5-10%, subject to limitation-on-benefits clauses and submission of a TRC. The reduced rate applies to the CIT component of FCT; VAT on royalties remains due unless an exemption applies.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VND 30 billion in total annual related-party transaction value or VND 50 billion in total annual turnover (exemption thresholds). If a taxpayer's annual revenue is below VND 50 billion and total related-party transaction turnover is below VND 30 billion, it is exempt from preparing the Local File and Master File, but it must still file the annual Form 01 Related-Party Transaction Disclosure with the CIT finalization return. Above either threshold, a compliant Local File, Master File, and TP benchmarking study must be prepared and retained within 30 days of a tax authority request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Viet Nam does not operate a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations regime; however, the Vietnamese tax administration applies substance-over-form, beneficial ownership, and general anti-avoidance principles. A digital webtoon syndication LLC must demonstrate real people, actual office facilities, functional decision-making, contractual assumption of risk, and value-creating activities in Viet Nam (editorial curation, platform management, licensing, subscriber support). An entity staffed solely by nominees or routing transactions through Viet Nam to exploit DTAs or defer tax will be disregarded, with income reallocated to the true economic owner and FCT assessed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Underdeclaration of Digital Sales Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to recognize gross revenue from Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, and webtoon chapter unlocks; reporting net revenue after store commissions as if it were taxable revenue; using offshore bank accounts or non-resident payment processors to hide Vietnamese-source digital sales; intentionally failing to file quarterly provisional CIT returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Tax Administration Law and Decree 125/2020/ND-CP, penalty equal to 20% of the underdeclared tax plus daily late-payment interest of 0.03%. Criminal exposure under Penal Code Article 200 includes fines up to VND 4,500,000,000 and imprisonment up to 7 years for large-scale tax evasion. Tax authority may freeze bank accounts, attach assets, and suspend tax codes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative, general director, and chief accountant are jointly and severally liable for short-paid tax. Directors may be subjected to temporary exit suspension (travel ban), asset seizure, and criminal prosecution. Imprisonment up to 7 years is available for deliberate and organized evasion schemes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Vietnamese LLC with no physical office, no employees, no local editorial or licensing staff, no board meetings in Viet Nam, and no operating bank account; using nominee directors or shareholders to create a paper entity; routing offshore webtoon copyright royalties and platform income through the shell to obtain DTA benefits or to shift profits out of tax authority visibility.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority may disregard the legal form, recharacterize all income earned by the shell as income of the foreign beneficial owner, disallow expenses, impose FCT on the deemed cross-border payments, assess additional CIT, apply a 20% penalty on the shortfall, and charge 0.03% daily interest. Administrative fines for false declarations or failure to keep books reach VND 25,000,000 and may be applied together with criminal sanctions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors and beneficial owners who sign false substance declarations face civil restitution, personal tax liability, and exit bans. Courts may pierce the corporate veil where the LLC is a facade. Criminal false-certification liability may result in imprisonment for the officers who certified non-existent operations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Non-Arm's-Length Transfer Pricing and Disguised Profit Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying excessive royalties to an offshore related company for webtoon copyright, charging inflated platform service fees, lending at non-commercial interest rates to a related foreign lender, or failing to prepare Local File, Master File, and annual Form 01 TP Disclosure. Also covers one-sided aggressive pricing designed to leave zero taxable income in Viet Nam while accumulating material profits with a foreign related party.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vietnam tax authority may adjust prices to the arm's-length standard, disallow excess interest and royalty deductions, reclassify disguised distributions, impose 20% penalty on additional CIT assessed, charge 0.03% daily late payment interest, and issue criminal referral for intentional manipulation. Excessive interest deductions are additionally capped by thin capitalization rules under Decree 20/2017/ND-CP.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and financial officers who knowingly certify false related-party transaction prices are personally liable for additional tax and penalties within the scope of their supervision. They may face asset freezing, exit bans, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion where the TP adjustment is accompanied by deliberate false documentation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using high-frequency webtoon micro-transactions through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing to layer illegitimate funds; structuring payments to remain below the Vietnamese large-transaction reporting threshold (VND 300 million equivalent); accepting subscription or unlock payments from shell wallets without customer-identification diligence; failing to maintain an AML risk assessment for digital payment flows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022, administrative fines for failure to implement AML, KYC, and reporting obligations may reach VND 500,000,000, in addition to suspension of digital payment channels. Money laundering under Penal Code Article 324 carries fines up to VND 5,000,000,000 and imprisonment up to 15 years. Payment processors may terminate the LLC's merchant accounts for AML non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and AML compliance officers who knowingly structure or fail to report suspicious payment behavior are personally exposed to criminal fines, travel bans, and imprisonment up to 15 years. The corporate veil is pierced in cases of deliberate misuse of the payment rails; directors also face civil restitution for illegally generated revenue.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Abusive DTA Relief and Erroneous FCT Withholding
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Claiming treaty-reduced withholding rates on royalties or interest without obtaining a valid Certificate of Tax Residency from the foreign recipient; using a jurisdiction-resident shell entity solely to access a lower treaty rate; mischaracterizing service fees or software payments as royalties to invoke treaty benefits; failing to withhold and remit FCT on cross-border payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority will deny treaty relief, require full domestic FCT withholding (effective 15% on royalties, 5% on interest), assess late-payment interest, and impose a 20% penalty on the additional tax. Fraudulent abuse of DTAs may escalate to tax evasion prosecution with fines and imprisonment, and the payment itself may be redetermined as taxable profit of the Vietnamese LLC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The CFO, legal representative, and any officer certifying false TRCs or beneficial-ownership declarations are personally liable for the unpaid withholding tax and penalties. They may be banned from leaving Viet Nam and may face criminal imprisonment for forging tax documents or making false statements to tax authorities.
